response.description: A taxonomic inventory process that is restricted to plots, transects, or points, in which a person or group of people is comprehensively covering the entire area, usually with a well-described survey time or pace. The search is restricted to a defined and human-scale geospatial area (usually traversable within a time course of less than a day) within which there is an expectation of a comprehensive accounting of the taxonomic items of interest.
response.label: restricted search taxonomic inventory process
